name: @gyral/mcp

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Gyral 0.3.1 documentation (guides, API reference, examples). Returns ranked sections with their URL; pass a URL to get_doc for the full text.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "hydrate island" or "formAction 422".

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Returns one docs page as markdown, or one section when the reference has a #anchor. Accepts a URL (https://gyral.dev/docs/forms/#the-server-half), a path (/docs/intent/) or a short name (intent, api/core, examples).

path_or_url.description: URL, path or page name, optionally with #anchor.

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Declaration, doc comment and import path of a public @gyral/* export (e.g. define, form, renderPage, step). Pass "*" to list every export, optionally for one package.

symbol.description: Exported name, e.g. "define", or "*" for the index.

package.description: Limit to a package or entry point: "core", "@gyral/ssr/static".

tools.name: list_examples
tools.description: Every runnable example in the Gyral repo with what it demonstrates. Read one with get_example.

tools.name: get_example
tools.description: An example's description, link and the full source of its component files.

tools.name: scaffold_component
tools.description: Idiomatic starting code: "basic" (state, intents, pure update, view, model test), "form" (schema-validated form that also works without JavaScript), "ssr-page" (light-DOM page, server route, client entry). Adapt it, then run check_snippet.

tag.description: Custom element name with a hyphen, e.g. "todo-list".

description.description: What the component should do (added as a comment).

tools.name: check_snippet
tools.description: Typechecks a TypeScript module against the project's installed TypeScript and @gyral/* types (the server's working directory, or GYRAL_PROJECT_DIR). Use it before presenting Gyral code.

code.description: A complete TypeScript module, imports included.

instructions: Gyral builds web components as Model-View-Intent loops with their own view layer (html, css, each, prop from @gyral/core): intent parses DOM events into typed messages, update is one pure reducer per message, view is a pure function of state that names intents with data-intent (no event handlers), and side effects are commands performed by drivers. Read the gyral://skill resource first. Use search_docs / get_doc for guides, get_api for exact signatures, get_example for working code, scaffold_component for a starting point, and check_snippet before presenting code.
